scope.source: Coded from ten job postings on startup.jobs published in the two weeks before 15 November 2026: five implementation roles and five deployment strategist roles at software vendors whose customers run physical operations, read with the same rules as my own engagement. Each cell is the middle of five roles; a column is one kind of role, not a whole team.

backing_key: The dot is how far I went; the ring is how far you can check it without me. From left to right: not in scope, described, built and tested outside a live system, answered for it in a live operation.
backing_limit: Field work is my own account: it illustrates, it does not validate. None of my systems has a client in production yet.
